claims.statement: The function `search` in `app.py` is located around line 133.
Version/tag `demo-v1` is affected by the leak.
The search handler runs its username query against the `users` table.
The search handler serializes each row with all four columns `id`, `username`, `email`, `bio`.
The search handler has no projection to public fields and no masking of the email column.
A query `GET /search?q=ali` returns the full user row including the `email` field.
The JSON response body for `?q=a` contains `alice@example.com`.
Searching `?q=o` against demo-v1 returns the emails of both `bob` and `carol` with no authentication, allowing bulk address harvesting.
